about.title: About Trackwise
about.subtitle: A minimal personal expense tracker with a focus on clarity.
about.content: Trackwise helps you understand your spending patterns, stay on top of your monthly budget, and visualize where your money goes. It offers clean dashboards, monthly and yearly insights, category-based breakdowns, and easy expense tracking. With built-in multilingual support, a customizable category system, a secure local-only storage model, and an intuitive interface, Trackwise gives you full control over your finances without compromising your privacy.
